label: Diagram 1.4
caption: Diagram 1.4
description: A section showing reduced headroom for loft conversions (see para 1.13). The stair is shown as a horizontal line, with a newel post and handrail at its right-hand side. A ceiling slopes up from left to right above it. At the low side of the stair the headroom is '1.8m'; at the middle of the stair, marked by a 'Half width of stair' dimension from the low side, it is '1.9m'. A note reads: 'Where there is not enough space to achieve 2m headroom reduced headroom as shown will be satisfactory'.
model_description:
Diagram 1.4 is a technical diagram titled 'Reduced headroom for loft conversions'. It depicts a side profile view of a stairwell area under a sloping ceiling. 

The drawing shows a vertical line representing a wall or boundary, with a horizontal line at the base representing the stair. A dimension line indicates the distance from the edge of the stair to a vertical line as 'Half width of stair'. 

From this point, a vertical line extends upwards, and a second vertical line is drawn to the right of it. A sloping line connects the top of these two vertical lines. A vertical dimension line on the left side shows a height of '1.8m' from the stair level to the start of the slope. A second vertical dimension line shows a height of '1.9m' to the point where the slope meets the second vertical line. 

Text on the drawing states 'See para 1.13' at the top left, and 'Where there is not enough space to achieve 2m headroom reduced headroom as shown will be satisfactory' positioned to the right of the sloping line.
